On keeping a notebook

They sat on the bank of the river and talked until the light faded. Nobody wrote anything down that evening, which she later regretted.

A notebook is a patient listener. It does not interrupt, it does not judge, and it never forgets the half finished thought you abandoned on Tuesday.

She finally broke the ice by reading aloud a single line, and the room relaxed immediately.

Technical vocabulary such as idempotent or eigenvalue deserves its own page, because definitions are easy to lose.
